entities.name: Ruric Thar
entities.description: Two-headed ogre warrior and chieftain of the Ghor-Clan of the Gruul on Ravnica.

entities.name: Ghor-Clan
entities.description: Gruul clan led by Ruric Thar.

entities.name: Borborygmos
entities.description: Gruul guildmaster whom Ruric Thar challenged and lost a hand to.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker telepath who hired Ruric Thar, later made Living Guildpact.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: Guild that tried to apprehend Jace.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Dragon who announced the Implicit Maze.

entities.name: Squelch
entities.description: Izzet goblin who helped Ruric Thar for chickens.

entities.name: Boros
entities.description: Guild whose guards troubled Ruric Thar.

entities.name: Supreme Verdict
entities.description: Event triggered when Jace linked the maze-runners' minds, making him Living Guildpact.

entities.name: Arrus
entities.description: Viashino tattooist who urged Ruric Thar to attack the Selesnya.

entities.name: Selesnya
entities.description: Guild accused of plotting to leech mana from the Rubblebelt.

events.summary: Jace hires Ruric Thar to destroy his research sanctum.
events.quote: Jace Beleren hired them to destroy his research sanctum

events.summary: Ruric Thar helps Jace escape the Azorius Senate and gains a fragment of his erased knowledge.
events.quote: Ruric Thar helped the telepath escape

events.summary: Jace confronts Ruric Thar in a duel, defeats him, and Ruric Thar offers to delay the Rakdos while Jace flees.
events.quote: The telepath channeled the minds of Ruric Thar's warriors against him

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet announces the Implicit Maze, interrupting the battle.
events.quote: Niv-Mizzet made the grand announcement of the Implicit Maze

events.summary: Ruric Thar, named the Gruul's maze-runner, is helped by Squelch against Boros guards.
events.quote: was helped out by the Izzet goblin named Squelch in return for chickens

events.summary: Ruric Thar completes the run and arrives at the Forum of Azor; Jace links the runners' minds, triggering the Supreme Verdict and becoming Living Guildpact.
events.quote: which made Jace Ravnica's new Living Guildpact

events.summary: Domri Rade replaces Borborygmos; Ruric Thar resents him and launches raids into the Tenth District.
events.quote: They channeled his anger into a series of brutal raids

events.summary: Arrus convinces Ruric Thar to attack the Selesnya.
events.quote: he convinced Ruric Thar to attack the Selesnya

events.summary: The Simic trap Ruric Thar with poisoned lamb and test them in a lab.
events.quote: Ruric Thar awoke in the middle of a Simic testing lab

relations.quote: the chieftain of the Ghor-Clan of the Gruul Clans on Ravnica

relations.note: one of the few to challenge him and live
relations.quote: They are one of the few beings to challenge Borborygmos and live
Ruric Thar and his host offered to delay them while Jace made his escape
